entries.bbe21e79440d0e35: Aiming to realize its ideal state 10 years from now, the company has redefined its corporate philosophy. Under its 3-year medium-term management plan “Ever Onward 2026,” covering fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026, it has set 4 priority measures (rebuilding the management base, establishing a solutions business, revitalizing the flat knitting machine business, and expanding the automatic cutting machine business) and is promoting proposals of products and services that support sustainable manufacturing in regions around the world.
